name: SAL + Analysis
description: Status meeting minutes plus an analysis section, for calls that cover both progress and new requirements.
description_it: Minuta di avanzamento con una sezione di analisi, per call che trattano sia lo stato dei lavori sia nuovi requisiti.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: 3-5 sentences: why the call took place, the overall state of the work, the main analysis topics and the outcome

sections.title: Participants
sections.instruction: Names of the people present, as they appear in the transcript. Generic labels such as 'Speaker A' or 'Parlante B' are not names: if no real name appears, write 'Not stated'

sections.title: Activity Status
sections.instruction: One row per activity, phase or deliverable explicitly discussed. Status is one of: Done, In progress, Blocked, Not started. Notes hold what was said about it (percentages, estimates, dates) only if stated

sections.title: Risks and Blockers
sections.instruction: Risks, delays, dependencies or blockers that were raised, with impact and mitigation only if discussed

sections.title: Analysis: Topics Discussed
sections.instruction: One bullet per analysis topic: a bold short title followed by 1-3 sentences on what was explained and the positions that emerged

sections.title: Analysis: Requirements and Rules
sections.instruction: Requirements, business rules and constraints that emerged. Type is one of: Functional, Non-functional, Business rule, Constraint. Source is who stated it, only if clear, otherwise 'Not stated'

sections.title: Analysis: Open Questions
sections.instruction: Doubts, missing information and points to clarify. 'Who answers' only if stated, otherwise 'Not stated'

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: Only points on which the participants explicitly agreed, on progress or on analysis. Proposals still to evaluate are not decisions

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Every task someone took on. 'Who' and 'By when' only if stated in the call, otherwise 'Not stated'

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: What happens after this call, including follow-up meetings or deadlines with their date only if stated
